description: This file contains functions and classes for loading and managing distributed checkpoint state dictionaries in PyTorch, including deprecated functions, detailed load procedures, and key-specific loading utilities.

classes.name: Stateful
classes.description: Represents objects with a state_dict and load_state_dict methods for checkpointing.

methods.name: load_state_dict
methods.description: Deprecated function to load a state dictionary into a storage reader, redirecting to _load_state_dict.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Main function to load a checkpoint into a distributed state dictionary, handling synchronization and planning.

methods.name: _load_state_dict
methods.description: Internal function to perform the actual loading of state dicts, managing planning, metadata, and data reading.

methods.name: _load_state_dict_from_keys
methods.description: Loads specific keys from a checkpoint into a new state dict, not distributed.
